notes.title: 7.30 Update Explanation
notes.content: [p]1. You can now use the controller to play this game.[/p][p]2. With English, foreign friends can experience it normally.[/p][p]3. Optimized the Halo Flying Sword ability.[/p][p]4. Fixed the issue of possible level interruptions.[/p][p]5. The background music has been updated.[/p]
